name: Nokia 3310

images.credit: SoonSoo90, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM (2G version), GSM/HSPA (3G version), GSM/TD-SCDMA/LTE-TDD (4G China Mobile (CMCC) version)

Body.Weight: 79.6 g (2G), 84.9 g (3G, Single-SIM), 88.2 g (3G, Dual-SIM), 88.1 g (4G, CMCC)

Platform.Operating system: Series 30+ based on MediaTek MAUI (2G), Java-powered Smart Feature OS, later Series 30+ based on Mocor RTOS (3G), AliOS (4G, CMCC)
Platform.Chipset: MediaTek MT6260 (2G), Spreadtrum SC7701B (3G), Spreadtrum SC9820A (4G, CMCC)

Memory.Storage: 16 MB (2G version), 128 MB (3G version), 512 MB (4G, CMCC version)
Memory.Card slot: microSD, up to 32GB (2G and 3G), microSD, up to 64GB (4G, CMCC)

Battery.Battery: 1200 mAh Li-ion (removable), standby time:, up to 31 days (2G), up to 27 days (3G, Single-SIM), up to 25.3 days (Dual-SIM, non-3G), up to 24 days (3G, Dual-SIM), up to 15 days (4G, CMCC, GSM-only), up to 12 days (4G, CMCC, TD-SCDMA or LTE-VoLTE)
